blocker_1_stale_or_missing_market_data.reconciled_fact: The local market store (.finance_market_store.db) contains exactly 61 distinct symbols. 6 of these (ARM, ASML, CPRX, NAUT, NVO, SPY) are external to the 500-candidate universe. Thus, exactly 55 symbols from the 500 universe are present in the store, and 445 symbols (89.0%) have ZERO daily candles (MISSING_MARKET_DATA). The reported number '439' arose from subtracting the 61 total store symbols from 500 (500 - 61 = 439). Furthermore, all 55 present symbols possess only 50 to 199 candles (none satisfy the 200 SMA or 222-day slope requirement for Weinstein/Minervini Stage 2), and 1 symbol (VRTX, latest date 2026-09-03) is severely stale (78 calendar days old).
blocker_1_stale_or_missing_market_data.applies_to: 500 Expansion Candidate (445 missing + 55 insufficient history) and 250 Promoted Universe (195 missing + 55 insufficient history)

blocker_2_missing_provenance_records.reconciled_fact: In the active local market store (.finance_market_store.db), the asset_ohlcv_provenance table has 0 rows, and the universe store (.finance_universe_store.db) tables have 0 rows. The historical figure of 67 symbols corresponds to the historical Issue #67 evidence quality audit and the 65 unresolved Stage 2 cases + 2 corporate action exclusions (KVUE, QRVO) from RADAR-015 where vendor attribution, timestamps, and adjustment traces were lacking.
blocker_2_missing_provenance_records.applies_to: Entire universe (table-level provenance tracking not yet populated in local SQLite store)

blocker_3_snapshot_release_lineage_diver.reported_claim: The published snapshot's release lineage differed from the deployed backend.
blocker_3_snapshot_release_lineage_diver.reconciled_fact: scanner_runner.py (line 93) defines CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_RELEASE_SHA = 'ed04de51160e0f2c3e82bd43d989897a4fd77f89'. The historical VCP snapshot (vcp-snap-1794040325-1a8a8f46) was published under release commit fe442119 / e766cf3c (Nov 7, 2026). The current authoritative backend release on release/production is 868d7afcd528006c2323e6b79b5a17f2f20f677c (PR #312), and the active deployed Railway worker container is 16549be1acb9fdafef3c6b97f9115b674f9f4842 (PR #309). Under scanner_runner.py line 1009, an implementation release SHA mismatch triggers fail-closed PIPELINE_PENDING (RELEASE_MISMATCH) and suppresses scanner execution.
blocker_3_snapshot_release_lineage_diver.applies_to: All Radar scanner endpoints serving live traffic
